newsitem.title: USA: Graham Corp names Cadena president, COO.
newsitem.headline: Graham Corp names Cadena president, COO.

text.p: Graham Corp said Monday it named Alvaro Cadena as its president and chief operating officer.
In a statement, the company said Cadena assumes the role of president of Graham Corp from Frederick Berkeley, who remains chairman and chief executive officer.
Cadena's role of chief operating officer at Graham Corp, is a newly created position, the company told Reuters.
Cadena will remain president and chief operating officer at Graham Manufacturing, in addition to his new duties.
Graham Manufacturing is the U.S. operating subsidiary of Graham Corp.
